###### Continued Repeat Orders Supporting Asian and North American MNO Deployments; More Than 3,000 Radio Units Now Deployed in North American Network


HAUPPAUGE, N.Y., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — AmpliTech Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMPG, AMPGZ) (the “Company” or “AmpliTech”), a designer, developer, and manufacturer of advanced radio frequency (RF) microwave components, 5G communication systems, and quantum computing low-noise amplifiers (LNAs), today announced that it received more than $17 million in customer purchase orders during the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


The quarterly total includes previously announced follow-on orders supporting existing 5G Open RAN programs for Asian and North American mobile network operators (“MNOs”). These repeat orders reflect continued purchasing activity under established customer programs and the ongoing commercial deployment of AmpliTech’s O-RAN technology.


Notably, more than 3,000 AmpliTech radio units have now been deployed in support of its North American MNO program, representing an important milestone in the commercial adoption and deployment scale of the Company’s technology.


In parallel, AmpliTech continues to pursue additional business opportunities with prospective customers, including active participation in large-scale requests for proposals (“RFPs”) for its O-RAN radio solutions. These opportunities remain subject to customer evaluations, competitive selection processes and the issuance of definitive purchase orders.


“We are pleased with our third-quarter order performance, which reflects continued purchasing activity from established customer programs and growing commercial experience with our O-RAN technology and product portfolios across our divisions” said Fawad Maqbool, Chairman and CEO of AmpliTech Group.


“Our focus is on building upon these successful deployments, strengthening relationships with existing customers and expanding our reach to additional mobile network operators and telecommunications infrastructure providers. The repeat orders, together with our active participation in new customer RFPs, support our strategy of scaling the O-RAN business as the industry continues its transition toward more open and flexible network architectures. We remain focused on converting these opportunities into firm orders, shipments and sustainable revenue growth,” concluded Mr. Maqbool.
**About AmpliTech Group, Inc.**


AmpliTech Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMPG, AMPGZ) is a designer, developer, and manufacturer of advanced RF and microwave signal processing components and next-generation 5G infrastructure systems. The company’s product portfolio spans low noise amplifiers, cryogenic amplifiers, Massive MIMO O-RAN radio systems, and 5G Network-in-a-Box solutions, serving customers across defense, satellite communications, quantum computing, and telecommunications. AmpliTech is the only American company to have designed and commercialized an O-RAN CAT B 64T64R Massive MIMO radio unit. All products are designed and engineered in the United States. For more information, visit[www.amplitechgroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HMUKKf81cLF-fumdjg1F_KB3pMSvoFRhVWnfxWaotprMtZv57SHOPgYlbJoc3d4BRc6hNPyR-omPYFqfkOnNtlVo14ZUqVsR-95ml_r97YM=)
